title: Python suite cannot collect: ccp_slot_hash_carry.json missing but consumer test committed
description: Discovered during full python pytest run while validating worker6-xxpn (relay signer oracle) on main 68c6e60d6f. tests/test_ccp_sync_vector_consumers.py (committed, last touched 827f73a057) loads test/vectors/ccp_slot_hash_carry.json at module import time (_cases(CARRY_HASH), line 543) but that vector file was never committed, so pytest collection of the whole file errors: FileNotFoundError. The full python suite cannot run without --ignore=tests/test_ccp_sync_vector_consumers.py. Fix: author/commit the ccp_slot_hash_carry.json vector corpus (u32-carry slot assignment via slot_for/slot_hash per the test's docstring) or temporarily skip the consumer module until the corpus lands.
